name: Cigarghast
look: a phantom shaped like a thick rolled cigar with a gold-and-red band, one glowing ember eye and smoky wraith arms
entry: Said to haunt old study rooms and velvet lounges, Cigarghast's glowing ember eye is often the only thing visible in the dark.
how: Use a Dusk Stone on Smolderstump.
Wild: rare, at night, in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
It learns Smoke Ring at level 21.
